title: Binomial-sum bound on low-degree supports
statement:
For natural numbers $n$ and $D$, let $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ denote the (finite) type of low-degree squarefree supports on $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, that is, the subsets $s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ with $\abs{s} \le D$. Then the number of such supports satisfies
\[
\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D}} \;\le\; \sum_{t=0}^{D} \binom{n}{t}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n and D (no further constraints)
replaced:
The number of low-degree squarefree supports satisfies
\[
\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D}} \;\le\; \sum_{t=0}^{D} \binom{n}{t}.
\]
